name: crypto
description: Cryptography for Bantu — OS-CSPRNG secure random (random_bytes, token_hex, token_urlsafe, random_int), HMAC-SHA256 with constant-time verification, HKDF-SHA256 (RFC 5869), and base64/base64url/hex encoding. Pure Bantu on native primitives. Symmetric encryption and password KDFs are intentionally out of scope (use a vetted native layer).
